# Miba Resistors

Die Miba Resistors ist ein international führender Hersteller in der Entwicklung und Produktion von
nicht-induktiven Dickschicht-Widerständen für die Hochleistungselektronik. Unsere technologisch hoch
anspruchsvollen Komponenten tragen dazu bei, dass Energie sicher und effizient umgewandelt und
übertragen wird. Ob Hochleistungswiderstände, Hochspannungswiderstände oder kundenspezifische
Ausführungen - unser Solution Team begleitet Sie über den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess.

# Gemeinsam entwickeln wir die optimale
# Widerstandslösung für Ihre Anforderung

 

Unsere Produkte sind in verschiedenen Leistungs- und Spannungsbereichen, Größen, engen Toleranzen
sowie Ohmwerten erhältlich.
Dank des technischen Know-hows und der langjährigen Erfahrung ist die Miba Resistors in der Lage
schnell und flexibel neuen Anforderungen zu entsprechen.

# Unsere Produkte zur Leistungselektronik im Überblick

[EBG Leistungswiderstand mit bis zu 600W] Wir sind führend in der Entwicklung von induktionsfreien
Dickschicht Leistungswiderständen, die besonders kompakt und leistungsfähig sind. Sie regulieren
etwa Spannungsspitzen, wie sie beim Ein- und Ausschalten von elektronischen High-End-Geräten
entstehen, und leiten Überspannungen ab.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][29]
Wir erzeugen eine große Bandbreite an unterschiedlichen induktionsfreien
Ultra-Hochleistungswiderständen. Für kleine Bauformen bietet die Miba Widerstände mit
Leistungsstufen zwischen 350 W und 3.000 W, die direkt auf Kühlkörpern montiert werden können
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][30]
[EBG Hochspannungswiderstand vor weißem Hintergrund] Unsere induktionsfreien
Hochspannungswiderstände sind besonders leistungsfähig. Sie können sehr hohe Spannungen regulieren,
um diese einfach messbar und den Umgang damit sicherer zu machen. Eine wichtige Rolle spielen die
Hochspannungswiderstände deshalb in Netzgeräten zur Energieversorgung von hochwertigen Maschinen wie
Röntgengeräten oder Laboranlagen.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][31]
[flache EBG Widerstände] Unsere Hochspannungswiderstände sind auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden
abgestimmt. Diese individuellen Spezifizierungen machen sie für die jeweiligen Anwendungen besonders
leistungsfähig. Sie sind zudem in der Lage, sehr hohe Spannungen zu regulieren, um diese einfach
messbar und den Umgang damit sicherer zu machen.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][32]
[EBG Ultra-Hochleistungswiderstand vor weißem Hintergrund] Wir produzieren Shunts in drei
unterschiedlichen Leistungsklassen und Vier-Kontakt-Kelvin-Anschlüssen. Die Widerstände zeichnen
sich durch hohe Isolationsfestigkeit und geringen Temperaturkoeffizienten aus. Anwendung finden
unsere Shunts beispielswiese in der Strommessung bzw. Stromüberwachung.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][33]
[EBG Metallschicht Widerstände vor weißem Hintergrund] Unsere Metallfilmwiderstände zeichnen sich
durch besonders hohe Genauigkeit hinsichtlich Ohmwert, Temperaturkoeffizient und Langzeitstabilität
aus. Wir bieten eine große Auswahl an verschiedenen Bauformen mit entsprechenden Leistungsklassen,
von radialen und axialen Bauformen bis hin zu nach MIL-Standard getesteten Elementen. Für extreme
Einsatzbedingungen gibt es auch gemoldete Bauformen.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][34]
[EBG Ultra-Hochpräzisionswiderstand vor weißem Hintergrund] Wir haben neue Materialkombinationen und
Verarbeitungsprozesse entwickelt, die einen TCR (thermischer Widerstandskoeffizient) bei Miba
Resistors typischem minimalen VCR (Spannungskoeffizient) von bis zu +/- 5ppm ermöglichen. Diese neue
Generation von hochpräzisen und hochstabilen Widerständen wird in ersten Anwendungen, zum Beispiel
in Strom- und Spannungsversorgungseinrichtungen in der Medizintechnik, bereits erfolgreich
eingesetzt.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][35]
[EBG Spannungsteiler vor weißem Hintergrund] Wir entwickeln und produzieren eine Vielzahl an
Bauformen und Größen von Spannungsteilen. Je nach Anwendungsgebiet (Luft, Öl, gepottet, etc.) werden
verschiedene Ausführungen hergestellt und bieten höchste Präzision und Stabilität.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][36]
[EBG Kohlenstoff Widerstände] Der Carbon widerstand wurde entwickelt, um eine optimale Lösung für
viele Anwendungen in der Leistungselektronik zu bieten, insbesondere für den Sanftanlauf und die
Hochspannungsentladung. Da sie von Natur aus nicht induktiv sind und transienten
Hochspannungsimpulsen standhalten können, ist die Carbon Disc-Serie ähnlich effektiv in Bezug auf
Dumping-Bremsschaltungen, Überspannungsschutz und Brechstangenentladungsanwendungen.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][37]
[kundenspezifische EBG Widerstände] Wir bieten Kunden eine Vielzahl an individuellen Lösungen an.
Durch unser hausinternes Testlabor können wir empirische Versuche sehr schnelle durchführen. Auch
individuelle Kleinserien sind gerne willkommen - damit Sie die Widerstände erhalten, die zum Erfolg
Ihres Produktes und Ihres Projektes optimal beitragen.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][38]
Wir haben ein breites Spektrum an Drahtwiderständen im Angebot. Sie decken unterschiedliche
Leistungsstufen und Größenverhältnisse ab.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][39]

Wir arbeiten kontinuierlich an neuen Produkten und der Erweiterung unseres bestehenden Portfolios.

# Miba Resistors – Das Unternehmen

Als international führender Hersteller von Hochleistungs- und Hochspannungswiderständen trägt wir,
Miba Resistors (ehemalig EBG Resistors), seit über **50 Jahren** dazu bei, dass Energie sicher,
effizient umgewandelt und übertragen wird.
Mit starker Innovationskraft arbeiten unsere Entwicklerteams an immer kleineren und immer
leistungsfähigeren Widerständen für unsere Kunden.

**Ganz nach dem Motto: Technologies for a Cleaner Planet.**

Ausgehend vom österreichischen Unternehmensstandort in Kirchbach in der Steiermark beschäftigten wir
weltweit über 500 Mitarbeiter und sind seit 2010 Teil der **Miba Power Electronics Group** – einem
weltweit operierenden Unternehmen mit 31 Standorten und mehr als 7.000 Mitarbeitern

# Branchen, die wir bedienen

Anwender und Hersteller von Komponenten zur Leistungselektronik profitieren von einem verlässlichen
Partner, der mit fundiertem Wissen auf die spezifischen Leistungsanforderungen reagieren kann.

 

Wir sind Ihr Ansprechpartner für Widerstandslösungen für elektrische Antriebe, Frequenzumrichter,
Wechselrichter, Stromversorgungen, Lade- und Entladevorgänge. Unsere Widerstände werden zum Beispiel
in Hochgeschwindigkeitszügen, Elektrofahrzeugen, in der Luft- und Raumfahrt, Medizintechnik,
[Energieübertragung][48] und -verteilung oder der Elektrifizierung eingesetzt.

- Antriebe für Industriemotoren
- Stromversorgungssysteme (Schweißen, Schmelzen, Laser, Medizin)
- Geräte und Instrumente

- Energieübertragung/-verteilung (HVDC, intelligentes Netz)

[ What are electronic components?
][121]

Electronic components are individual devices or parts that are used to build electronic circuits.
They include resistors, capacitors, transistors, diodes, integrated circuits, and many other types
of devices.

[ Where are electronic components used?
][122]
1. Electronic components are used in a wide range of applications, including consumer electronics,
   telecommunications, automotive, industrial equipment, medical devices, and more. They are
   essential for the functioning of electronic devices and systems.

[ How do I choose the right electronic components for my project?
][123]

Choosing the right electronic components depends on various factors such as the requirements of your
project, desired performance characteristics, compatibility with other components, and cost
considerations. It's best to consult with a knowledgeable supplier or engineer who can guide you in
selecting the most suitable components for your specific application.

[ What factors should I consider when selecting electronic components for my project?
][124]

Selecting the right electronic components is crucial for the success of your project. Here are some
important factors to consider during the component selection process:
1.  Specifications: Review the specifications of the components, including voltage rating, current
    rating, operating temperature range, package size, and electrical characteristics. Ensure that
    the components meet the requirements of your project.
2.  Quality and Reliability: Choose components from reputable manufacturers or suppliers known for
    producing high-quality and reliable components. Look for components that meet industry standards
    and certifications.
3.  Compatibility: Ensure that the selected components are compatible with other components in your
    system or circuit. Check for compatibility in terms of electrical requirements, pin
    configurations, and communication protocols.
4.  Availability: Consider the availability and lead time of the components. Check if they are
    readily available in the market or if there could be potential supply chain issues that may
    impact your project timeline.
5.  Cost: Evaluate the cost of the components and consider your project's budget constraints.
    Compare prices from different suppliers, but also consider the overall value, including quality
    and reliability, rather than solely focusing on the lowest price.
6.  Application-Specific Considerations: Take into account any specific requirements of your project
    or application. This could include environmental considerations (e.g., temperature, humidity),
    specific performance criteria, or industry-specific compliance standards.
7.  Future Scalability and Support: Consider the scalability of your project and future expansion or
    upgrades. Choose components that allow for flexibility and compatibility with future
    developments. Also, assess the availability of technical support and documentation for the
    selected components.
8.  Lifecycle and Obsolescence: Evaluate the lifecycle of the components and their potential for
    obsolescence. Consider the longevity of the components and the availability of alternative
    options if a component becomes obsolete.
9.  Supplier Relationships: Consider the reputation and track record of the component suppliers.
    Look for suppliers that provide good customer support, reliable delivery, and after-sales
    service.
10. Testing and Validation: Plan for testing and validation of the selected components to ensure
    they meet the desired performance and functionality for your project.

[ What are electronic components?
][121]

Electronic components are individual devices or parts that are used to build electronic circuits.
They include resistors, capacitors, transistors, diodes, integrated circuits, and many other types
of devices.

[ Where are electronic components used?
][122]
1. Electronic components are used in a wide range of applications, including consumer electronics,
   telecommunications, automotive, industrial equipment, medical devices, and more. They are
   essential for the functioning of electronic devices and systems.

[ How do I choose the right electronic components for my project?
][123]

Choosing the right electronic components depends on various factors such as the requirements of your
project, desired performance characteristics, compatibility with other components, and cost
considerations. It's best to consult with a knowledgeable supplier or engineer who can guide you in
selecting the most suitable components for your specific application.

[ What factors should I consider when selecting electronic components for my project?
][124]

Selecting the right electronic components is crucial for the success of your project. Here are some
important factors to consider during the component selection process:
1.  Specifications: Review the specifications of the components, including voltage rating, current
    rating, operating temperature range, package size, and electrical characteristics. Ensure that
    the components meet the requirements of your project.
2.  Quality and Reliability: Choose components from reputable manufacturers or suppliers known for
    producing high-quality and reliable components. Look for components that meet industry standards
    and certifications.
3.  Compatibility: Ensure that the selected components are compatible with other components in your
    system or circuit. Check for compatibility in terms of electrical requirements, pin
    configurations, and communication protocols.
4.  Availability: Consider the availability and lead time of the components. Check if they are
    readily available in the market or if there could be potential supply chain issues that may
    impact your project timeline.
5.  Cost: Evaluate the cost of the components and consider your project's budget constraints.
    Compare prices from different suppliers, but also consider the overall value, including quality
    and reliability, rather than solely focusing on the lowest price.
6.  Application-Specific Considerations: Take into account any specific requirements of your project
    or application. This could include environmental considerations (e.g., temperature, humidity),
    specific performance criteria, or industry-specific compliance standards.
7.  Future Scalability and Support: Consider the scalability of your project and future expansion or
    upgrades. Choose components that allow for flexibility and compatibility with future
    developments. Also, assess the availability of technical support and documentation for the
    selected components.
8.  Lifecycle and Obsolescence: Evaluate the lifecycle of the components and their potential for
    obsolescence. Consider the longevity of the components and the availability of alternative
    options if a component becomes obsolete.
9.  Supplier Relationships: Consider the reputation and track record of the component suppliers.
    Look for suppliers that provide good customer support, reliable delivery, and after-sales
    service.
10. Testing and Validation: Plan for testing and validation of the selected components to ensure
    they meet the desired performance and functionality for your project.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

### Standards

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

After a long day at work or after a full week of caring for your home and children, it is time for
relaxation, your **hobby hour**. Hobbies will keep you occupied between work and family, and
cultivating a good hobby may have calming or helpful therapeutic side effects.

Hobbies are practiced for enjoyment and interest, rather than financial reward. Engaging in a hobby
can lead to acquiring substantial knowledge, skill and experience, but the most important gain is
your personal fulfillment.

What are hobbies for some people are professions for others: a programmer may enjoy [guitar
playing][4] as a hobby, while a professional musician might enjoy programming. But remember that
Linux began as a student's hobby.

A hobby doesn't have to cost a fortune to be enjoyable. Activities like [sport fishing][5] can be
maintained for a reasonable amount spent on equipment and travel, paper-making requires little more
than junk mail and a blender, and so on.

[Eurasian Hobby] **The history of the word "hobby":**
Falconry was a very popular pastime in the Middle Ages and the "Eurasian Hobby" was perhaps the most
popular bird used for this sport.
An alternative origin for the word can be accounted for a recreational animal called hobby - a type
of small ambling or pacing horse. A hobby-horse was a wooden toy made to be ridden just like the
real hobby. From this came the expression "to ride one's hobby-horse", meaning "to follow your
favorite pastime", and in turn, hobby in the modern sense of recreation.

[Metal detecting]

There are hobbies for every personality, lifestyle and budget. Popular hobbies often involve
**collecting items** like coins, stamps, baseball cards, **working with your hands** like sewing,
embroidery or performing an **outdoor activity** like climbing, hiking or bird watching.

Creating something **useful** or making a **handcrafted item** for decoration can be both practical
and profitable. Acting, play writing, poetry, playing an instrument, collecting music tapes, or
writing song lyrics are all good ways to spend a quality time.

**Radio controlled** model cars, airplanes, helicopters or boats have opened up a wide spread,
interesting recreational activity. Previously sold as toys, today's RC devices are expanding rapidly
in complexity and variety.

Board and card games like chess, checkers or mah-jongg are a great way to stimulate your mind and
meet new people.

If you are looking for a hobby to fill your leisure time, visit our page about today's most [common
hobbies][29]. This is not a complete list, but it may help you get started.

We hope you'll find a hobby that you feel is right for you. Just remember that the most important
thing is that you have fun with whatever hobby you choose!

real hobby. From this came the expression "to ride one's hobby-horse", meaning "to follow your
favorite pastime", and in turn, hobby in the modern sense of recreation.

Hi, I do not think the relay itself is the main problem. The controller is probably checking the
valve coil current all the time, and during relay switching it sees an open circuit, so it gives the
coil interruption error. You may need a “make-before-break” type switch, or an electronic
MOSFET/solid-state switch that changes over without disconnecting the load. Can you tell me the coil
voltage, coil current, and the relay type you are using? A simple circuit may solve the problem.

## Application & Technical Support

We work with industrial and OEM customers to review specifications, confirm product configurations,
coordinate testing and production, and support product-related application questions.
* Specification Review
  
  We review electrical ratings, dimensions, mounting requirements, drawings, datasheets, and
  reference samples before quotation or production.
* Product Configuration & Customization
  
  Standard products can be matched to the application, while custom configurations can be developed
  according to confirmed technical requirements.
* Testing & Production Coordination
  
  We coordinate sample review, production requirements, electrical testing, and applicable
  inspection records according to the confirmed specifications.
* Application Assistance
  
  Remote support is available for product selection, installation clarification, and product
  integration questions. On-site assistance may be arranged for selected projects.

[LEEYD Engineering Team]

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about specifications, customization, testing, lead times, and international
delivery.

What information should I provide for a quotation?
Please send the product category or model, key electrical specifications, estimated quantity,
application, and target delivery date. Drawings, datasheets, or reference photos are helpful when
available.
Can you manufacture according to our drawing or reference sample?
Yes. We can review drawings, datasheets, product photos, or physical samples and confirm whether the
required specifications can be matched or customized.
Do you support samples and small trial orders?
Yes. Samples and trial orders are available for many products. Availability, sample cost, and lead
time depend on the product and customization requirements.
What are your typical production lead times?
Lead times vary by product, quantity, and customization level. Standard products and small batches
may be completed faster, while customized or volume orders are confirmed after specification review.
Can you provide test data or inspection reports?
Test data, inspection records, and relevant compliance documents can be provided for applicable
products. Please let us know your documentation requirements before ordering.
Do you support international shipping?
Yes. Orders can be shipped by express, air, sea, or customer-appointed forwarders, depending on the
product, quantity, and destination. Standard export packing and shipping documents can also be
arranged.

## Application & Technical Support

We work with industrial and OEM customers to review specifications, confirm product configurations,
coordinate testing and production, and support product-related application questions.
* Specification Review
  
  We review electrical ratings, dimensions, mounting requirements, drawings, datasheets, and
  reference samples before quotation or production.
* Product Configuration & Customization
  
  Standard products can be matched to the application, while custom configurations can be developed
  according to confirmed technical requirements.
* Testing & Production Coordination
  
  We coordinate sample review, production requirements, electrical testing, and applicable
  inspection records according to the confirmed specifications.
* Application Assistance
  
  Remote support is available for product selection, installation clarification, and product
  integration questions. On-site assistance may be arranged for selected projects.

[LEEYD Engineering Team]

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about specifications, customization, testing, lead times, and international
delivery.

What information should I provide for a quotation?
Please send the product category or model, key electrical specifications, estimated quantity,
application, and target delivery date. Drawings, datasheets, or reference photos are helpful when
available.
Can you manufacture according to our drawing or reference sample?
Yes. We can review drawings, datasheets, product photos, or physical samples and confirm whether the
required specifications can be matched or customized.
Do you support samples and small trial orders?
Yes. Samples and trial orders are available for many products. Availability, sample cost, and lead
time depend on the product and customization requirements.
What are your typical production lead times?
Lead times vary by product, quantity, and customization level. Standard products and small batches
may be completed faster, while customized or volume orders are confirmed after specification review.
Can you provide test data or inspection reports?
Test data, inspection records, and relevant compliance documents can be provided for applicable
products. Please let us know your documentation requirements before ordering.
Do you support international shipping?
Yes. Orders can be shipped by express, air, sea, or customer-appointed forwarders, depending on the
product, quantity, and destination. Standard export packing and shipping documents can also be
arranged.

and Air Coils for power electronics, energy storage and industrial control applications.

## About Us

**CHANGZHOU YUANSHENG TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD**

**Reliable Power Resistor Solutions for Industrial Electronics**

Since 2013, Changzhou Yuansheng Technology has been specializing in the design and manufacturing of
high-performance passive components for industrial applications.

Our core products include **ultra-low inductance high power resistors, dynamic braking resistors,
PCB metal shunt jumper bars, manganin/constantan shunt resistors, SMD alloy resistors, ceramic
cement resistors, and air core coils**. These components are widely used in industrial automation,
power electronics, motor drives, energy storage systems, power supplies, and other demanding
applications where stable performance and long-term reliability are essential.

With manufacturing partners and production resources across Jiangsu and surrounding regions, we
combine engineering support, flexible customization, and reliable production capability to meet
different application requirements. From prototype development to volume production, we work closely
with customers to provide practical resistor solutions based on electrical performance, mechanical
requirements, and application conditions.

 

Learn More

Our focus is not only supplying components, but helping customers reduce design risks through
consistent quality, accurate specifications, and dependable technical support.

**Yuansheng Technology — Your trusted partner for industrial power resistor solutions.**

Our team works closely with customers to understand electrical, mechanical, and application
requirements, providing reliable resistor solutions with flexible customization, responsive
technical support, and competitive cost advantages. By combining consistent quality, stable supply
capability, and efficient manufacturing processes, we help customers achieve better performance and
cost balance for their industrial applications.

## The Value We Bring to Your Projects

From component selection to production support, we help customers achieve reliable resistor
performance through engineering expertise, consistent quality, flexible customization, and
dependable supply.

### Reliable Performance

Consistent materials and manufacturing control ensure stable resistance performance and reliable
power handling.

### Application Engineering Support

Technical support for resistor selection, customization, and application requirements from prototype
development to production.

### Accurate Power Capability

Designed with reliable power handling capability to reduce overheating risks and ensure stable
operation under demanding conditions.

### Flexible Manufacturing

Supporting customized specifications, small-batch prototypes, and volume production with responsive
manufacturing capability.

## Solutions Designed for Industrial Power Systems

Reliable resistor solutions for power electronics, industrial control, and energy applications

### Power Electronics Applications

Motor drives, power supplies, and energy systems..

### Thermal & Load Management

Energy absorption and current control.

### Custom Component Solutions

Resistance values, dimensions, and specifications.

wirewound and [high precision resistor solutions][56] for their manufacturing needs. Riedon is able
to offer every required resistive solution, on time with the very best performance possible.

Consider how essential it is to protect expensive electrical components that are exposed to sudden,
extreme voltage changes. The right resistive solutions prevent hazardous situations that can occur
within specialized electronic technology when less reliable resistors are in use. Keep in mind that
customized microprocessors are vulnerable to power surges which threaten to cause irreparable damage
such including total data loss. Riedon specializes in the optimal manufacturing of surge protection
circuits designed specifically to prevent such expensive losses. When customized protection circuits
are in use sudden voltage or current changes will not damage the intricate components of specialized
electronic equipment.

The best news is that Riedon can customize resistive solutions specifically designed to meet the
needs of any cutting-edge manufacturer. Riedon offers these types of resistive solutions: [precision
wirewound][57], [current sense][58], high surge, [high pulse][59], [surface mount][60] and [power
resistors][61]. Riedon is proven to be the best in the industry at providing premium, cutting edge
resistors that exceed expectations for reliability and performance. Every resistor created at Riedon
is carefully crafted with a standard of excellence rarely matched in the industry. Manufacturers
trust Riedon as proven by years of incredible [customer support][62] alongside outstanding product
performance.

[Riedon][63] has been committed to bringing the best custom, high quality resistive solutions to
customers around the globe since 1960. Riedon provides wirewound and high precision resistors to the
most unique and original manufacturers of cutting edge technical solutions. Our superior solutions
are designed to off the extreme stability throughout the functionality of the original equipment
needs. This includes environments that involve extreme temperature changes. We can design any
solution required for any custom product requirements, delivered faster than anyone else in the
industry. Check out our track record and you will discover that we offer only excellence with
adherence to the highest standards for manufacturing as well as customer service.

## **What We Offer**

In general, resistive solutions will be found as either thick or thin film as well as resistive
wiring. The purpose of the thick and thin film option is for a chip style solution designed for
direct integration into a printed circuit. Riedon understand the challenges involved with circuit
designs for custom product needs. Our manufacturing process is second to none, incorporating all
solutions required for the correct amount of heat dissipation in order to avoid overheating or other
destructive problems. The resistors designed by Riedon offer the best in optimal function as a
result of consistent application of the best fabrication and design processes.

Bring your customized resistor needs to Riedon and we are sure to have the best solution. Our
resistive expertise is all encompassing, including the following:
* [Custom Resistors][64]
* [Current Sense / Shunt Resistors][65]
* [Precision Resistors][66]
* [Wirewound, Thick Film and Thin Film][67]

* [High Power and TO Type][69]
* [High Voltage][70]
* [Surface Mount][71] and Through Hole designs
* [Leaded Resistors][72]

Riedon has the right type of resistor for your unique technology needs. Wirewound resistors
manufactured by Riedon are designed using alloys that are widely varied. Custom wirewound solutions
include important factors such as Temperature Coefficient of Resistivity (TCR) or alloy resistivity.
Whether your needs are customized or require standard resistors, Riedon supplies the very best
product on the market within the strict timelines you need

Riedon has played an integral role in the updated design and manufacturing process of resistors. In
the past, lead resistors were much larger and performed in a less effective manner. Today Riedon
leads the industry in best practices for resistor designed for any type of power needs. Our team of
experts know how to account for all essential design factors including those related to temperature
coefficient and noise. We take the time to analyze all parameters required by each customer, taking
time to reach out as needed to problem solve as needed to ensure complete satisfaction. We encourage
you to browse the website and connect with our customer support team who can connect you with the
expert design services available for your product needs.

## **Why Choose Riedon?**

For more than fifty years Riedon has been a trusted industry name for the most creative cutting-edge
technology advancements. When it comes to customer service and product reliability no one else out
performs Riedon. Riedon offer the best innovative resistive technology to support the most
influential components on the market today. Their passion for ultimate precision and customer
satisfaction is deeply rooted within their years of dedication to the very best resistive solutions.
Trust your best technology to the most experienced resistor company in the business.

Check out the website for specified information that makes it much easier to order the exact product
you need, delivered when you need it. While browsing the website our highly qualified customer
service representatives are available for your convenience if any questions arise. We have extensive
experience working with high-end customers that require careful customer relation management. All of
these factors and more make Riedon the ideal option for any resistor needs.

As a manufacturing company Riedon now offers an expedited customer service option that allows for
faster product completion times to those who require the fastest possible turnaround time on the
market. Riedon is uniquely able to offer ideal, quick delivery options without compromising the
ideal manufacturing standards that has made Riedon the leader in the resistor industry for decades.
Talk to our customer service representatives to learn how you can be part of the exclusive group of
customers enjoying delivery times up to four times faster than our competitors.

Based on Riedon's commitment to excellent customer service, Riedon has announced [that they are now
offering expedited customer service][73]. Riedon customers continue to enjoy quick turnaround when
ordering. The California-based manufacturing company boasts the fastest delivery while maintaining
the same high-quality products for which the firm is known. Riedon offers many of its clients a
delivery period four times faster than its previous turnaround time.

Our manufacturing process allows for optimal consistency of production in order to meet the needs of
each customer. [Contact us][74] today for more information about how we can provide you with the
best resistive solution in the shortest amount of time.

leads the industry in best practices for resistor designed for any type of power needs. Our team of

coefficient and noise. We take the time to analyze all parameters required by each customer, taking
time to reach out as needed to problem solve as needed to ensure complete satisfaction. We encourage
you to browse the website and connect with our customer support team who can connect you with the
expert design services available for your product needs.

Sichuan Qixing Electronics Co., Ltd. is specialized in manufacturing high-power resisters,
wire-wound potentiometers, trimmer potentiometers, rotary carbon potentiometers, precision parts and

instrument measuring appliances, cable TV equipments, electrician products, color television, color
console, video and audio products and many other products. In order to maintain a leading position
in the industry, we have further strengthened our product development ability. Moreover, we took the
lead in introducing the world leading high temperature polymerization furnaces from the USA to

certain contribution to the motherland national defense and the thriving of our economy. "Technical

company's quality policy, and "let customers be satisfied completely" is our goal. All our staff
